title: 第013章 酒池肉林英灵殿第014章 金色词条 叹息壁垒
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 苏业看着莉莉丝带着塔丽丝和其她基因禁军离开了至高协议的大厅。
莉莉丝能想到的事情，苏业自然也能想到。
“绝对的秩序，是因为自己的意志衍生吗？”苏业不由的想到塔丽丝的表现。
好像还真是这样，秩序阵营的兵种，好像都是某种存在的意志或者理念的衍生，现在自己成为了这种意志理念。
所以塔丽丝才会表现的如此，完全不像是秩序阵营的兵种，更何况是绝对的秩序。
自己的所思所想，对于塔丽丝来说，就是绝对的秩序和规则。
“原来如此。”苏业松了一口气，本来还有点担心，但是现在看来完全不用担心了。
换句话来说，在莉莉丝的眼中自己是至高的混乱，在塔丽丝的眼中自己是绝对的秩序，这两者冲突吗？
并不冲突，因为都是自己，只是在莉莉丝和塔丽丝的眼中自己代表的意义不同，唯一相同的是她们都忠诚于苏业。
“这就是恒定的忠诚度吗？爱了爱了。”苏业脸上带着笑容，走出了大厅。
看着不远处灵源湖畔，莉莉丝正带着原罪堕天使和塔丽丝携带的基因禁军和平共处了起来。
自己则是查看起了自己获得的两座奇观。
姓名：酒池肉林
等级：异宝
面积：500平方米----1000平方米
特性1：无限食物（无限生成任何钻石级和钻石级以下的食物酒水。）
特性2：自动清洁
特性3：忠诚度+10
特性4：幸福度+10
ps:有了它，你再也不用担心，食物的问题了，可自由切换古代建筑和现代建筑两种建筑模式。
“不愧是异宝级的奇观。”苏业有些咂舌的看着手中的古色古香的建筑模型。
能够生成钻石或者钻石级以下的酒水和食物，一般的食物可是没有品级的，黑铁级别的食物就有特殊的作用，比如说强化身体，灵力之类的东西。
更何况钻石级的食物和酒水了，能够无限供应。
特殊属性的食物和酒水，在领主世界之中不要卖的太昂贵，食物很少，主要是保质期不长，基本上没有，但是酒水可是硬通货，基本上可以存放很久的。
“要不要卖呢？”苏业带着一丝犹豫，随后还是选择了放弃。
酒水这些东西都是属于大商会垄断的，这玩意自己出手，那就是在找死，真的去卖只有两条路。
一条被人家收编当小弟，另外一条就是死。
那些大商会可不会容忍这样的存在，别忘了，这个世界可是真的有成为神明的领主，那些大商会其实就是各个家族联合起来的巨大商业利益集团。
背后有神明级别的领主坐镇不是什么奇怪的事情，这玩意目前在领主的市场上是属于垄断的，现在苏业还玩不起这个。
“算了，现在别想这些东西了太远了，这不是小说是现实，那些大商会是真的宁杀错不放过，有任何嫌疑，不管有没有证据，祂们可不讲这个。”苏业摇了摇头。
content_en:
Su Ye watched Lilith leave the hall of the Supreme Agreement with Talis and the other genetic imperial troops.
Su Ye can naturally think of things that Lilith can think of.
"Is absolute order derived from one's own will?" Su ye couldn't help but think of Talis' performance.
It seems that this is indeed the case. The arms of the order camp seem to be derivatives of some kind of will or idea of ​​existence, and now they have become this will idea.
That's why Talis behaved like this. She didn't look like a soldier from the order camp at all, let alone one from the absolute order.
What she thinks is absolute order and rules to Talis.
"That's it." Su ye breathed a sigh of relief. He was a little worried at first, but now it seems that there is no need to worry at all.
In other words, in the eyes of Lilith, she is the supreme chaos, and in the eyes of Talis, she is the absolute order. Do the two conflict?
There is no conflict, because they are both themselves, but they represent different meanings in the eyes of Lilith and Talis. The only thing in common is that they are both loyal to Su Ye.
"Is this constant loyalty? I love you, I love you." Su ye walked out of the hall with a smile on his face.
Looking at the Lingyuan Lake not far away, Lilith was peacefully coexisting with the original sin fallen angels and the genetic forbidden army carried by Talis.
He himself looked at the two wonders he had obtained.
Name: Jiuchi Roulin
Level: exotic treasure
Area: 500 square meters----1000 square meters
Feature 1: Unlimited food (unlimited generation of any food and drinks at diamond level and below.)
Feature 2: Automatic cleaning
Feature 3: Loyalty +10
Characteristic 4: Happiness +10
ps: With it, you no longer have to worry about food problems. You can freely switch between ancient architecture and modern architecture.
.............
"It is truly a treasure-level wonder." Su ye looked at the antique architectural model in his hand with some stunned words.
It can produce drinks and food that are diamond or below diamond level. Ordinary food has no level. Black iron level food has special effects, such as strengthening the body, spiritual power and the like.
What's more, diamond-level food and drinks are available in unlimited supply.
Food and drinks with special attributes should not be sold too expensively in the world of lords. There is very little food, mainly because the shelf life is not long, and there is basically none. But drinks are hard currency and can basically be stored for a long time.
"Do you want to sell it?" Su ye hesitated for a moment, but then chose to give up.
Things like drinks are monopolized by big chambers of commerce. If you do it yourself, you are looking for death. There are only two ways to sell it.
One is taken in as a younger brother, the other is dead.
Those big chambers of commerce will not tolerate such an existence. Don't forget, there are real lords who have become gods in this world. Those big chambers of commerce are actually huge business interest groups united by various families.
It's not strange to have a god-level lord sitting behind him. This thing is currently a monopoly in the lord's market, and Su ye can't afford it now.
"Forget it, don't think about these things too far now. This is not fiction but reality. Those big chambers of commerce really would rather kill the wrong than let go. If there is any suspicion, no matter whether there is evidence or not, they will not talk about it." Su Ye shook his head.
